column7: #2837 shape 2 (FUZZ-SEEDS-1, FuzzStorageFaultOperations input ae01600000): the outcome-agnostic auth-budget writes (RecordPasswordResetAttempt, RecordSSOBeginAttempt, RecordFailedLogin -> budgetRecord) used one plain, non-idempotent RecordLoginAttempt, so one transient storage error moved the attempt off the shared login_attempts table into the per-process fallback (no row, an auth.rate_limit_error audit event, an attempt other replicas never count) and a lost acknowledgement was counted twice (stored + memory). REST POST /auth/password-reset RecordLoginAttempt#1/error answered 200 with oracle (a) [LoginAttempt AuditEvent]. Fixed by routing every budget write through the login reservation's keyed, once-retried idempotent write (budgetWriteKeyed, #3050). Class guard: TestAuthBudget_EveryStoredWriteIsKeyed; fuzz pin: server/faultops TestPasswordResetAttemptAccounting_PassesEveryOracleWithoutARow plus seeds 2837_passwordreset_*.
